title: Fetch the blob once when a registry ignores multi-range requests
body:
Some registries (S3-backed ones, minio) don't support multi-range requests and answer them with a 200 and the full blob.  For zstd:chunked layers we then read and discarded most of the blob twice: once to get the TOC and tar-split, and again for the file contents.

c/image now returns a new private.FullBlobResponseError when a request for part of a blob (anything other than a single chunk at offset 0) gets a 200, instead of reading the body.  It is mapped to the new chunked.ErrFullBlobResponse in zstdFetcher.

In c/storage, NewDiffer wraps the image source in a fullBlobFallback.  On ErrFullBlobResponse it downloads the whole blob once into an unnamed temporary file under the graph root and serves the TOC and all later requests from it, including convert_images.  The file is released when the differ is closed.

The download is limited to the expected blob size.  Partial pulls keep working with local deduplication, and the network cost is one copy of the blob.
